title: 第二十八章 硬核普法第二十七章 不让我家好那大家都别好
slug: 诸天影视从四合院开始
content_zh:
黄丽娟摔在碎玻璃堆上的时候，整个人像一只被摔散了骨架的母鸡，后背硌着参差的玻璃茬子，疼得她呲牙咧嘴。
但真正让她从地上爬不起来的是叶晨那双眼睛，一个十六七岁的少年，脸上淌着血，连擦都没擦一下，就这么居高临下地俯视着她，目光里既没有愤怒也没有恐惧，冷得像腊月里的铁栏杆。
黄丽娟在油田混了二十多年，见过不少狠人，那些在社会上有名号的大混子她也不是没打过交道。
可那些人再凶也带着三分盘算，而面前这个少年脸上那副“我弄死你也不用偿命”的平静，让她后脖梗的汗毛一根根地竖了起来。
黄丽娟忽然意识到自己犯了多大的蠢，自家男人偷油被抓是铁板钉钉的事儿，李大海只给了一个开除的处分，没有网上报案，没有移交公安，那已经是念在二十年老职工的份上留了最后一点情面。
她今天是被人三言两语撺掇着来闹的，有人在背后跟她说“你闹得越凶李大海越不敢把你们家怎么样”“他是领导最怕丢脸”。
可惜黄丽娟忘了，即便是领导也分软硬，李大海看起来是个好说话的主儿，可他家养的崽子，咬起人来比他老子还狠呢。
黄丽娟跪在碎玻璃中间，看着叶晨转身去扶牛玲玲的背影，之前那股撒泼的劲头像被戳破了的气球，噗地瘪了下去。
她抹了一把脸上的灰和泪，也不管背上隔着玻璃茬子疼不疼了，连滚带爬地从地上站起来，两腿一软，扑通一声跪在牛玲玲面前，一把抱住她的大腿，变脸的速度比唱戏还快。
刚才还是尖牙利嘴的悍妇，这会儿哭得涕泪横流，肩膀一耸一耸的，声音里带着那种故意放大了的、恨不得整栋楼都听见的凄惨：
“玲玲！玲玲啊！千错万错都是老嫂子我的错！我不该来你们家闹！我是猪油蒙了心呐！
我家刘刚已经被单位给开除了，要是再被关进去，我们全家就真的没法活了！他可是我们家的顶梁柱啊！
玲玲，我求求你了，你跟李肆说说情，让他待会儿别跟公安局乱讲，我给你磕头了！”
说着，黄丽娟真的把脑袋往地板上磕下去，脑门磕在地板上发出“梆梆”的闷响，磕了足足三下，头发散了一半，看上去又狼狈又疯癫。
牛玲玲被她抱着腿，低头看着这个前一秒还在扯自己丈夫衣服、抓儿子脸的悍妇，此刻跪在地上磕头如捣蒜，心里也说不清是什么滋味。
她下意识地往后退了一步，想把黄丽娟给扶起来，又觉得这女人刚才的所作所为实在没法让人同情，手伸在半空中进退两难。
叶晨没给牛玲玲心软的机会，他从旁边走过来，一只手扶着母亲的胳膊，轻轻把她带到了一边，自己挡在了母亲前面，低头看着跪在地上的黄丽娟，嘴角浮起一丝冰冷的弧度。
他开口的时候声音不大，但每个字都咬得清清楚楚：
“黄姨，我姑且还叫你一声姨。你这会儿知道怕了？晚了。你这不是知道错了，你这是怕了。你要是早知道自己理亏，就不会来我们家撒野。
现在来都来了，闹也闹了，把我爸衣服给扯了，脸挠了，把我们家的茶几给砸了，我的脸划花了，然后你想拍拍屁股走人？做什么美梦呢？

我今天心情好，顺带着给你普普法，省得你觉得我们一家人欺负你，不懂法。
你老公刘刚在油田干了二十年，他知道输油管线的走向，知道监控摄像头的死角，他伙同外面的人里应外合偷原油，这叫什么？职务侵占，最少也是盗窃共犯。
你们家偷的那些油都不是一次两次了，按吨算，起码百吨起步，你知道百吨原油值多少钱吗？
八十年代的“两高”司法解释就定了，盗窃公私财物三万元以上就够得上“数额巨大”，今年的新刑法虽然改了起刑点，但百吨原油折价下来，判个十年往上都是轻的。
而且你们家刘刚不光是偷油那么简单，他在输油管道上打孔，那东西一漏油、一遇明火，整条管线都能炸上天。
这事儿往大了说，叫破坏易燃易爆设备罪，比盗窃罪重多了，两罪并罚，你老公能不能全心全意地出来，都得看他命够不够硬了。
至于你，寻衅滋事故意损毁财物，还把我们父子俩弄成了轻微伤，够你进去蹲一阵子了。我们家不接受调解，这话是我说的，我相信在我爸妈那里这点主我还是能够做的。”
叶晨这可不是在唬人，虽然当时监控摄像头这种东西在国内很少见，可是林七油田好歹也是国内的第二大油田，七十年代就研制出钻孔彩色电视了，九十年代更是探索出视频监控、红外报警等防范措施。
黄丽娟跪在地上的身子晃了两晃，嘴唇翕动着，想再说什么，可嗓子眼里发出的只有一连串含混的呜咽，像是被什么东西死死扼住了喉咙。
她的肩膀耷拉下来，整个人像泄了气的皮球，缩在地板上缩成了一小团。
李大海始终站在沙发旁边没动，他那一千多块一件的挺括衫在当时绝对算得上是高奢了，可此时却被扯得七零八落，领子都被扯变形了。脸上那几道抓痕已经开始结痂了，暗红色的线在颧骨上横着。
他的目光落在自己儿子身上，那个满脸是血的少年站在一堆碎玻璃中间，条理清晰地给一个撒泼的女人普法，这着实让他有点意外。
李大海忽然想起叶晨生病之前，那个时候他还是个只知道打游戏、闯祸、写检讨的混小子，再看看眼前这个满脸血痕却挺直腰杆的少年，他喉结上下动了动，什么话都没说。
但此时他心里已经打定了主意：既然事情闹到了这一步，那就索性掀翻桌子，爱怎样怎样了。谁动他儿子，他跟谁玩命。
九七年是个特殊的年份，从去年四月开始的第二轮严打虽然到今年二月刚刚收尾，但雷霆之势未减。
新修订的《刑法》十月一日刚刚正式实行，公检法系统上下都绷着一根弦，正是抓典型、办大案的敏感期。
叶晨那个电话打出去的时候，接线员从头到尾听完了全程。从黄丽娟的嘶吼厮打，到玻璃茶几碎裂的脆响，再到叶晨冷静清晰的报警陈述，全被录进了电话录音里。
接线员当时就把案子转到了油田分局刑侦支队，附了一则备注：“受害者家属正在遭受暴力袭击，声音可辩，疑似寻衅滋事，建议立即出警。”
警笛声从油田家属院门口响起来的时候，距离叶晨挂断电话不到十分钟。两辆警车一前一后驶进楼下的空地，警灯旋转的红蓝光映在单元门口的墙面上，把围观邻居们的脸照得明明灭灭的。
因为李大海是油田的领导，所以他住的这栋楼里，住户也大多是油田的管理层。即便是家属有的像牛玲玲一样，不在油田工作，可是最基本的觉悟也还是有的。

从黄丽娟疯狂砸门开始，但凡是听到动静的，她们全都从屋里出来，汇聚到了李家门口，所以事情的发生经过，她们看得一清二楚，纷纷七嘴八舌的对来的民警控诉。
“李主任刚刚熬了两个大夜，抓了伙偷油贼，就被这个疯婆娘找上门来撒泼了。”
“我认得这个婆娘，她叫黄丽娟，她老公是刘刚，因为参与偷油，刚被厂子里给开除了！”
“这婆娘真不是人啊，连这么小的孩子都不放过，你看看李肆脸上的口子，看着都吓人，她心怎么就那么狠啊？！”
content_en:
When Huang Lijuan fell onto the pile of broken glass, her whole body looked like a hen whose frame had been broken apart. There were jagged glass stubbles on her back, which made her grin with pain.
But what really made her unable to get up from the ground was Ye Chen's eyes. A boy of sixteen or seventeen years old, with blood dripping from his face, didn't even wipe it off, just looked down at her condescendingly, with neither anger nor fear in his eyes, as cold as iron railings in the twelfth month.
Huang Lijuan has been working in the oil field for more than 20 years and has met many ruthless people. It is not like she has never dealt with those big gangsters who are well-known in society.
But no matter how fierce those people were, they were always calculating, and the calm expression on the face of the young man in front of her, "I won't kill you even if I kill you," made the hairs on the back of her neck stand up one by one.
Huang Lijuan suddenly realized how stupid she had been. It was a sure thing that her man would be caught stealing oil. Li Dahai only gave him a punishment of dismissal, without reporting the case online or handing it over to the police. This was just to save the last bit of kindness for the sake of a twenty-year-old employee.
She was encouraged to cause trouble today by a few words. Someone said to her behind her back, "The more you make trouble, the less Li Dahai will dare to do anything to your family." "He is the leader who is most afraid of losing face."
It's a pity that Huang Lijuan forgot that even leaders can be divided into soft and hard. Li Dahai seems to be a good talker, but his little son bites people harder than his father.
Huang Lijuan knelt in the middle of the broken glass, watching Ye Chen turn around to help Niu Lingling's back. The previous playful energy deflated like a punctured balloon.
She wiped away the dust and tears on her face, and regardless of whether the stubble on the glass hurt her back or not, she climbed up from the ground and stood up from the ground. Her legs softened, and she knelt down in front of Niu Lingling with a plop, hugged her thighs, and changed her face faster than she was singing in an opera.
She was a shrew with sharp teeth and a sharp mouth just now, but now she was crying with tears streaming down her face. Her shoulders were hunched up and down, and her voice was deliberately amplified with a misery that she wished the whole building could hear:
"Lingling! Lingling! All the mistakes are my fault, sister-in-law! I shouldn't have come to your house to make trouble! I was deceived by lard!
My Liu Gang has been fired from his workplace. If he is imprisoned again, our whole family will really not be able to survive! He is the backbone of our family!
Lingling, I beg you, please intercede with Li Si and tell him not to talk nonsense to the Public Security Bureau later. I kowtow to you! "
As she said that, Huang Lijuan really knocked her head to the floor. Her forehead hit the floor with a muffled "bang bang" sound. She knocked it three times, and half of her hair was scattered. She looked embarrassed and crazy.
Niu Lingling was hugged by her legs, looking down at this shrew who was tearing off her husband's clothes and scratching her son's face just a second ago. Now she was kneeling on the ground and kowtowing like garlic, and she couldn't explain how she felt.
She subconsciously took a step back, trying to help Huang Lijuan up, but felt that what this woman had just done was really unsympathetic, so she stretched her hands in mid-air and was in a dilemma.
Ye Chen didn't give Niu Lingling a chance to relent. He walked over from the side, held his mother's arm with one hand, and gently took her to the side. He stood in front of his mother, looking down at Huang Lijuan who was kneeling on the ground, with a cold arc at the corner of his mouth.
When he spoke, his voice was not loud, but every word was pronounced clearly:
"Aunt Huang, let me call you aunt. Are you afraid now? It's too late. You don't know that you are wrong, you are afraid. If you had known that you were in the wrong, you wouldn't have come to our house to act wild.
Now that I've come and made a fuss, my dad's clothes were torn off, his face was scratched, our coffee table was smashed, my face was scratched, and then you want to pat your butt and leave? What are you dreaming about?
I'm in a good mood today, so I'm going to educate you on the Fa so that you won't think that our family is bullying you and doesn't understand the Fa.
Your husband Liu Gang worked in the oil field for two yearsFor ten years, he knew the direction of the oil pipeline and the blind spots of surveillance cameras. He collaborated with people outside to steal crude oil. What is this called? Job embezzlement is at least an accomplice to theft.
The oil your family stole was not once or twice. In terms of tons, at least 100 tons starts. Do you know how much 100 tons of crude oil is worth?
The judicial interpretation of the "Two Highs" in the 1980s determined that stealing public and private property of more than 30,000 yuan is considered a "huge amount." Although this year's new criminal law has changed the starting point of punishment, at the discount of 100 tons of crude oil, a sentence of ten years or more is still light.
And your Liu Gang didn't just steal oil. He drilled holes in the oil pipeline. If that thing leaked oil or encountered an open flame, the entire pipeline could explode into the sky.
If this matter is taken seriously, it is called the crime of destroying flammable and explosive equipment, which is much more serious than the crime of theft. Both crimes are punishable. Whether your husband can come out wholeheartedly depends on whether his life is strong enough.
As for you, you deliberately damaged property by causing trouble, and even slightly injured our father and son, enough for you to go in and squat for a while. Our family does not accept mediation. This is what I said. I believe that I can still do this with my parents. "
Ye Chen was not bluffing. Although surveillance cameras were rare in China at that time, Lin Qi Oilfield was the second largest oil field in the country. In the 1970s, drilled color TVs were developed. In the 1990s, preventive measures such as video surveillance and infrared alarms were explored.
Huang Lijuan's body swayed while kneeling on the ground, her lips moved, and she wanted to say something else, but all that came out of her throat was a series of vague sobs, as if something was tightly strangling her throat.
Her shoulders drooped, and her whole body shrank into a small ball on the floor like a deflated rubber ball.
Li Dahai stood still next to the sofa. His crisp shirt, which cost more than a thousand dollars a piece, was definitely considered a luxury at the time, but now it was torn to pieces and the collar was torn out of shape. The scratches on his face have begun to scab, and dark red lines run across his cheekbones.
His eyes fell on his son. The young man with his face covered in blood was standing among a pile of broken glass, and he was explaining the law to a misbehaving woman in a clear and logical manner. This really surprised him.
Li Dahai suddenly remembered that before Ye Chen fell ill, he was still a gangster who only knew how to play games, get into trouble, and write self-criticisms. Then he looked at the young man in front of him with bloodstains on his face but his back straight. His Adam's apple moved up and down, but he didn't say anything.
But at this time, he had already made up his mind: since the matter had reached this point, he would simply overturn the table and do whatever he wanted. Whoever touches his son will risk his life.
1997 was a special year. Although the second round of crackdown that started in April last year ended in February this year, the momentum of the Thunder has not diminished.
The newly revised "Criminal Law" has just been officially implemented on October 1, and the public security system and the judicial system are all tense. It is a sensitive period for catching typical cases and handling major cases.
When Ye Chen made the call, the operator listened to the whole thing from beginning to end. From Huang Lijuan's yelling and fighting, to the crisp sound of the glass coffee table breaking, to Ye Chen's calm and clear alarm statement, everything was recorded in the phone recording.
The operator transferred the case to the Criminal Investigation Detachment of the Oilfield Branch at that time, and attached a note: "The victim's family is being violently attacked, the voice is indiscernible, and it is suspected of provoking quarrels and provoking trouble. It is recommended to call the police immediately. "
When the siren rang from the door of the Oilfield Family Courtyard, it was less than ten minutes after Ye Chen hung up the phone. Two police cars drove into the open space downstairs one after another. The red and blue lights of the police lights were reflected on the wall at the door of the unit, illuminating the faces of the neighbors who were watching.
Because Li Dahai is the leader of the oil field, most of the residents in the building where he lives are the management of the oil field. Even if some of her family members, like Niu Lingling, do not work in the oil field, the most basic thing isThere is still some awareness.
From Huang Lijuan's frantic smashing of the door, everyone who heard the noise came out of the house and gathered at the door of Li's house. Therefore, they could see clearly what happened, and they all complained to the police who came.
"Director Li just stayed up two long nights and caught a group of oil thieves, and then this crazy woman came to her door to cause trouble."
"I recognize this woman, her name is Huang Lijuan, and her husband is Liu Gang. He was just fired from the factory for participating in oil theft!"
"This woman is really not a human being. She won't even let such a small child go. Look at the cuts on Li Si's face. It's scary. Why is she so cruel?!"
